answer_text: The maximum height for constructions with an autre destination (not principal habitation) under UMG Article 10.2 is 18 metres (c-01)[Pour les constructions ayant une autre destination : la hauteur maximale des constructions est limitée à 18 mètres]. The same article sets 20 metres with a limit of R+5 for principal habitation (c-02)[Pour les constructions à destination principale d'habitation : ... limitée à 20 mètres, avec un nombre de niveaux limité à R+5] and 25 metres for principal service public or intérêt collectif (c-03)[Pour les constructions à destination principale d'un service public ou d'intérêt collectif : 25 mètres].
discrepancy_note: The numeric rule is confirmed. However, the planner's examples (hébergement hôtelier or résidence services as the 'autre destination' cases) are not confirmed by the source: the Article 10.2 text does not name any residence type, and dependency answers Q04 and Q05 both returned not_found for classifying a Résidence Jeunes Actifs or the RSE. The rationale also omits that the 18 m rule excludes principal service public/intérêt collectif destinations, which have their own 25 m limit.
additional_context: The 18 m limit applies only if a building is not principal habitation and not principal service public/intérêt collectif. Whether the RSE or Résidence Jeunes Actifs falls under habitation (20 m, R+5) or under autre destination (18 m) is not resolved by the source text, which is silent on residence types in Article 10.2. Article 10.2 also requires compatibility with the OAP (pièce n°3), a separate constraint not assessed here.
